response.text:
I can’t access or modify your calendar (no calendar tools available), so I can’t cancel events directly.

Please confirm exactly what you want me to do before I prepare a cancellation notice or instructions:

- Confirm cancellation target (reply one):  
  a) Cancel both recurring series (Tues 09:00 CT — 12 attendees; Thurs 15:00 CT — 4 attendees) starting tomorrow (2026-07-13).  
  b) Cancel only the Tuesday series.  
  c) Cancel only the Thursday series.

- Confirm attendee notification (reply one):  
  i) Notify attendees with a cancellation notice.  
  ii) Do not notify attendees (just remove from my calendar — note: I can’t perform removal).

- If you choose to notify, do you want a custom message? If yes, paste the message; otherwise I will draft a short default cancellation message.

Please reply with your choices (e.g., “a, i, default message”) to confirm.
